question: Will Monster Beverage (MNST) beat quarterly earnings?
rule_summary: YES only if next quarterly official earnings release reports GAAP diluted EPS (basic only if diluted not published) strictly greater than $0.31, rounded to nearest cent. Market creation metadata says estimated release 2026-10-29. If no release within 45 calendar days of that estimate, NO; if official release omits GAAP EPS, SeekingAlpha fallback, with NO if no figure within 96h of 4pm ET on announcement day. Subsequent revisions do not count except obvious immediate mistake. USD; figures in U.S.-traded common shares.
